text: Notice regarding payment confirmation in respect of registeration for mid-term examination, 2026 *Dated: 01.09.2026*  *NOTICE*  *Subject: Payment Confirmation in respect of registration for Mid-Term Examination, 2026 (Regular/Re-appear) *  All students are hereby informed that the registration process for the Mid-Term Examination, 2026 (Regular/Re-appear) is ongoing on the  portal upto 5th September, 2026. All students are advised to note that after completing the registration and submitting the requisite examination fee/payment on the portal, the payment              clearance/confirmation status will take a minimum of two (2) working days to be updated and reflected against their registration. Students are therefore requested to:  1. Complete their registration well within the stipulated deadline, keeping the 2-day clearance period in mind.  2. Refrain from making duplicate payments in case the status does not reflect immediately after payment.  3. Check the portal after 2 working days for confirmation status before contacting the examination office.  4. Retain the payment receipt/transaction ID for reference until confirmation is reflected on the portal.  In case the payment clearance/confirmation is not updated even after 2 working days, students may contact the Examination Office at conduction@igdtuw.ac.in along with proof of payment.  This is issued for the information and compliance of all students appearing in the Mid-Term Examination, 2026 (Regular/Re-appear).  Examination Division  IGDTUW, Delhi
